p: again the anger of the LORD: Before they were plagued with famine, 2Sa 21:1.
he moved David against them to: The Lord permitted Satan, as in 1Ch 21:2.
number of the people: Because he did this to determine his power and to trust in it, it offended God, for otherwise it was lawful to number the people, Ex 30:12, Nu 1:2.
eight hundred thousand valiant men that: According to Joab's count: for in all there were eleven hundred thousand, 1Ch 21:5.
five hundred thousand men: Including the Benjamites with them, or else they had but four hundred and seventy thousand.
seer: Whom God had appointed for David and his time.
seven years of famine come unto: Three years of famine were past for the Gibeonites and this was the fourth year to which should have been added another three more years, 1Ch 21:12.
Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand: From the one side of the country to the other.
stay now thine hand: The Lord spared this place, because he had chosen it to build his temple there.
done: David did not see the just cause why God plagued the people, and therefore he offers himself for God's correction as the only cause of this evil.
as a king: That is, abundantly, for as some write, he was king of Jerusalem before David won the tower.
fifty shekels of silver: Some write that every tribe gave 50 which makes 600, or that afterward he bought as much as came to 550 shekels.
